- Episode title: Woah: It Was Erika Kirk Who Called For TPUSA To Invite Me!? | Candace Ep 275
- Series title: Bride of Charlie investigation / Candace Owens
- Source used for analysis: YouTube transcript (yt-dlp-manual caption source, cleaned with video context) + video timestamps
- Transcript completeness status: Full transcript provided; cleaned (lexicon + paragraph merge). Music cues dropped.
- New Nodes Introduced: N-308, N-309, N-311, N-10294
- Existing Nodes Reused: N-1 (Charlie Kirk), N-2 (Erika Kirk)

Episode 42 advances two distinct lines within the Bride of Charlie record. The first centers on the dispute over TPUSA's December 15, 2025 live stream response. The artifact material presented includes an audio segment from the Charlie Kirk Show in which Blake Neff states the invitation response was directed and approved by Erika Kirk and that in-person attendance is "intuitive" for authenticity; a separate read-aloud of Nef's earlier "sincere" Phoenix invitation statement; and a subsequent Blake Neff X post asserting the engagement was "not how you book a guest." A separate artifact documents the Charlie Kirk Show's reported fall to #94 on Apple Podcasts.

The second line extends the UVU September 10 footwear and witness analysis. The host presents UVU footage emphasizing multiple young men wearing maroon shirts alone in the crowd, identifies UVU school colors as green and white, cites viewer emails linking maroon to airborne-forces identification conventions worldwide, and draws attention to two specific individuals (Jacob Kasparian and Adam Bartholomew) and to the apparent absence of family social media acknowledgement by Kasparian following the shooting. Additional artifacts include a PBS clip of witness Emmanuel Bierer and a follow-up phone-call summary with the individual who filmed one of two videos of the alleged roof subject. The episode also features an audio and lyric excerpt of The Game's track "The Assassination of Candace Owens."

The structural importance of the episode lies in compiling testimonial and on-screen material into two investigative streams: (1) the TPUSA invitation/authenticity dispute and (2) the UVU attendance pattern and witness selection, each anchored to discrete evidentiary families.

lines: - Name uncertainty: "Erika Kirk" is used throughout this episode transcript; existing node is "Erika Kirk." Spelling variance preserved as presented in this episode. Verify prior episodes for canonical spelling.
- Name uncertainty: "Andrew Kolvet," "Andrew Kolvet," "Andrew Kolvet" appear in this transcript for what appears to be the same individual. Spelling not normalized.

- Transcript ambiguity / possible transcription error: "Jacob Kasparian" appears consistently in this episode, but one reference reads "Jacob Kasparian" (at approximately 27:51, in context of Carrie Bartholomew's location). Treat as transcription error pending verification.

- Artifact verbally referenced but not shown: Some UVU footage stills (A-1505.3, A-1505.4, A-1505.6) were verbally described and superimposed rather than shown as clean still frames. Requires human verification.
- Timestamp uncertainty: Side-angle roof video shooter's follow-up call (A-1509.1) – exact date not specified in transcript.
- Timestamp uncertainty: A-1507.1 (Apple Podcasts ranking tweet) – original publication timestamp not specified.
- Transcript ambiguity: The Game's "Zion and Nasam" lyric may be a transcription artifact; the precise lyric should be verified against the released track.
- Claim failed admission test: "Maroon boys were tasked with taking footage from predetermined angles" (host's theory) – not inscribed; classified as Speculation.

- Claim failed admission test: "None of [Jacob Kasparian's] family members posted anything about Charlie's assassination" – not inscribed as artifact-anchored claim; classified as Investigative Observation pending social media audit.
- Claim failed admission test: Host framing premises ("this is a deep state assassination," "they are lying") – not inscribed.
